t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes always appear in the same pairs of colours, even if they are in different positions. Their size and shape doesn't matter but their colour determines which forest you will go to when you click on it. There are two types of forest - one which is bright and one which is dark. The goal is to always get to the forest that gives you the most mushrooms. The main aim of the advice is to keep a track of how many mushrooms are coming from each forest, and then remember which gnomes lead you to which forest.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes will appear in fixed pairs - their positions may vary but they will always be in the same pairs. These pairs are blue/purple, red/yellow, green/pink, and orange/brown. Each gnome will lead you to a different forest - one is bright with a red basket, and the other is dark with a yellow basket. Orange/green/red/blue take you to the bright forest, and brown/pink/yellow/purple take you to the dark forest.You must get to the forest that has the most mushrooms. This may change throughout the game, but generally if you're getting to a forest that is giving you 7/8/9 mushrooms, then keep trying to get to that forest until it stops giving you high numbers. I haven't quite worked out when/why it changes, but the forest which gives you the most mushrooms does change throughout the game. Everything else bar the colour of the gnome's hat is irrelevant as far as I can see. Good luck!
